notablePrerequisites:
Patron of the Orochi in graveyard with a sticker on it.
You control Forests that tap for at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Patron of the Orochi from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures.
Tap those permanents to add at least {4}{B}.
Sacrifice Patron of the Orochi to Altar of Dementia, milling target player seven cards.
Repeat.
